name: ControlRig Tools
description: RQL module for Unreal's Control Rig: author procedural animation rigs without C++ (look-at / aim, two-bone and full-body IK, traces, springs: any rig unit with its settings, links and rig variables) and wire them into Anim Blueprints (a Control Rig node before Output Pose, its inputs bound to Anim Blueprint variables set every frame, e.g. from the nearest target); query rigs, their graphs, variables and hierarchy, and Control Rig components.
_comment: Install-catalog metadata (one unreal-mcp-cli ExtensionDescriptor). 'version' is the .uplugin VersionName; change both with `python scripts/extension_release.py bump --plugin <Plugin> --version <x.y.z>`. 'tools' is empty: the extension adds an RQL module (docs/rql.md), not MCP tools. 'minCoreVersion' is the lowest supported Unreal-MCP core; 'enginePlugins' are the engine plugins the installer enables.
